method: Full-sheet inspection across all 44 accepted source batches, plus original-resolution inspection of revision-4 standalone/edit/transform overrides

Original-resolution inspection of all six required split-rule sheets, all eleven revision-4 overrides, the six crops named by CPO review, all replacement-controlled rows and the standalone slow-camera application

All 427 generated panels were re-cropped from detected high-luminance gutter bounds rather than assumed equal-cell coordinates; every crop carries source dimensions, detected separators and exact coordinates
Constraint check for visible text-like glyphs, logos, watermarks, signatures, crop contamination, target readability and material fixed-variable consistency
globalFindings: Revision-1 post-hoc panel-selection suffixes were removed from exact generation prompts; panel row, column, role, target and crop coordinates are separate lineage fields.

The 70-candidate gutter screening queue was invalidated by deterministic gutter detection and complete re-cropping; the six named failure examples now contain one clean panel each with no neighboring content.

Depth of field and slow-camera remediation remain accepted; Skin tone, both below-viewpoint roles, rear application, low transmission and both Dutch-roll directions now use eleven per-example revision-4 overrides with hash-bound target observations.

The revision-3 below-viewpoint application false positive is superseded by a direct edit whose convex underside and circular foot dominate the frame from a physically lower camera position; the interior cavity and top opening are completely hidden.
globalLimitations: High-density generic sheets are reviewed as complete sheets plus risk-stratified original panels; independent CPO review must still sample panel-level semantics before acceptance.

Identity-defining dimensions cannot preserve literal identity while changing age or facial/body geometry; the three Skin-tone anchors instead share one direct medium reference and preserve recognizable facial geometry, amber-brown iris color, hair, expression, wardrobe, crop and light.
Still images represent motion and focus-transition controls through observable motion blur, settling and focal-plane cues; temporal fidelity remains limited until separately authorized video scope.
